question: Which minister was in the news to launch the country's first crash testing programme 'Bharat NCAP', on 22 August 2023?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Nitin Gadkari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nitin Gadkari** is the Minister for **Road Transport and Highways** in India.
 
• He was in the news for launching the country's first crash testing programme, **'Bharat NCAP'**, on **22 August 2023**.
 
• 'Bharat NCAP' stands for **Bharat New Car Assessment Programme**.
 
• The programme aims to enhance the **safety standards** of vehicles in India.
 
• It is a significant step towards ensuring that vehicles sold in India meet **international safety standards**.
 
• The initiative is expected to improve the **overall safety** of vehicles and reduce the number of **road accidents**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Raj Nath Singh**__

 __
 
• Raj Nath Singh is the **Minister of Defence** of India.
 
• He has previously served as the **Home Minister** of India.
 
• He is a senior leader of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**.
 
 
 
• **Amit Shah**__
 __
 
• Amit Shah is the **Minister of Home Affairs** in India.
 
• He is also the **Minister of Cooperation**.
 
• He has been a key strategist for the **BJP**.
 
 
 
• **Ashwini Vaishnaw**__
 
 
• Ashwini Vaishnaw is the **Minister of Railways**, **Communications**, and **Electronics & Information Technology** in India.
 
• He is known for his efforts to modernize the **Indian Railways**.
